## What's new

- **Connect BigBrain on this Mac in one click.** Local BigBrain now sets itself up from a single **Connect BigBrain on this Mac** button. Ficus finds your BigBrain install and its vault, so you no longer write a bindings file or copy a client ID by hand. End-to-end use with the BigBrain app on a packaged Mac install has not been verified yet.
- **Clearer shared BigBrain vaults.** The vault handle field explains what it is for, BigBrain shows its desktop app icon, and new shared vaults on Ficus Cloud get addresses that start with your instance's name.
- **BigBrain connections shut down cleanly.** Closing a BigBrain connection no longer hangs when a process it started keeps running in the background.
- **Icons that follow your theme.** The Dock icon follows the theme of the window you're using, and the app's icons and favicon match each built-in theme.
- **Easier sign-in to attached installations.** Signing in to an attached installation now starts with browser sign-in, with the in-app passkey as the alternative, and the passkey page is clearer.
- **Chat shows more.** Tool calls that write files show their full content in chat, and the composer's context ring shows a whole-number percentage.
- **Smaller fixes.** Connection lifecycle logging makes dropped live updates easier to diagnose.
